entities.name: Tong Hua
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ren Haiyan, known by her pen name Tong Hua or Zhang Xiaosan, is a Chinese contemporary romance novelist and screenwriter. She graduated from Peking University and emigrated to America in 2005. She currently lives in New York City.
